title: Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) Panel Pakistan 2026 — Detuned Reactor-Capacitor Banks, NEPRA PF Penalty Avoidance, Sizing Methodology & PKR Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete Pakistan buyer guide for APFC panels 2026. Covers NEPRA PF penalty structure (0.85 threshold), detuned reactor-capacitor bank selection for VFD-heavy environments, KVAR sizing methodology with worked example, summer ambient derating (45–50°C), generator island-mode instability risk and controller configuration, capacitor-duty contactor (AC-6b) requirements, CT sizing, Modbus SCADA integration, PKR price table (50 KVAR to 1,000 KVAR), 10-point selection checklist, 7 common mistakes in Pakistan, commissioning checklist, and 6-question FAQ.
